topic: One tap checkout with saved cards everywhere vs deleting stored cards to add friction (Isaac vs Geraldine)

scenes.narration: Saved card numbers turn a thirty second pause into a purchase. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a phone with a giant BUY NOW button and a tiny pause icon, comic burst banner reads ONE TAP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isaac and Geraldine both shop online and earn the same salary.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man isaac and woman geraldine each holding a phone with shopping apps, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isaac saves his card in every app and browser.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man isaac tapping SAVE CARD on five different apps, card icons everywhere, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Late at night, one tap buys gadgets he forgets by morning.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man isaac in bed at midnight tapping BUY, packages piling at the door by sunrise, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His small orders add up to three hundred dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading THREE HUNDRED A MONTH, a pile of unopened boxes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty six hundred dollars a year of stuff he barely remembers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man isaac confused in front of a closet of unopened gadgets, a tag reads THIRTY SIX HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Geraldine deletes every saved card from every app and browser.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman geraldine tapping DELETE CARD across apps, card icons vanishing in puffs, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Now every purchase means getting up and finding her wallet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman geraldine on the couch looking across the room at a wallet on a shelf, a thought bubble reads IS IT WORTH IT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Most nights she decides it is not worth the walk.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman geraldine closing the app and going back to her book, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her impulse spending drops to sixty dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a scoreboard reading SIXTY A MONTH, a thin stack of packages, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isaac spent thirty six hundred. Geraldine spent seven twenty and kept the rest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man isaac buried in boxes, woman geraldine watching a savings chart rise, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delete the saved cards. Make spending take effort. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading DELETE SAVED CARDS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
